article_content: (CNN) -- Many were in diapers, if they were born at all, during Whitney Houston's heyday in the late 1980s and early 1990s. And yet they still feel a special connection to her -- and, today, share in the heartache of their parents and neighbors by virtue of the fact that they all call northern New Jersey home. Mario Depeine said that students in the public middle school in Newark where he teaches cannot stop talking about Houston, adding they are upset that there is no large-scale public memorial at which they can pay their respects. Most were not alive when she won her first Grammy Award in 1986 for best female pop performance for her song 'Saving All My Love For You.' Still, Depeine -- a CNN iReporter -- said the middle-schoolers know Houston's music through their parents as well as her unique place in Newark lore. 'They know her well,' he said. 'And they realize that she's really connected to this community.' The legendary singer is hardly the first person born in Newark to make a mark on the world. Comedian Jerry Lewis, musician Paul Simon and poet Allen Ginsberg, among many others, arose from the city of about 275,000 people, situated 10 miles west of New York City. Yet Houston has a special connection because -- according to public leaders, family friends and other residents -- she never forgot her roots in Newark, where she was born, and nearby East Orange, where she moved as a child. Houston family's farewell to be private. 'It's very sad because, in reality, she's a part of here,' said German Racines. 'She is a little piece of Newark.' Pastor Joe Carter from New Hope Baptist Church in Newark, which Houston attended growing up, recalled how she would come and sing at some Easter Sunday services even after she'd made it big. Others recalled fondly how Houston would often return to the area, treating neighbors and fellow church members like family. 'It's almost like she never left,' said Sharpe James, a former Newark mayor who organized concerts for a young Houston as well as her mother, gospel singer Cissy Houston. 'Here's a superstar, but you could find her in Newark, at the church. She was everywhere and everything to everyone.' Pride tied to her enormous talents, and her fame, are also part of her appeal in the Garden State. Gov. Chris Christie told reporters Tuesday that he believes Houston belongs in the same class as Frank Sinatra, Count Basie and Bruce Springsteen as far as musical luminaries hailing from New Jersey. To pay tribute, he said he plans to order all flags at government buildings be lowered to half-staff Saturday, the day of her funeral. 'Whitney Houston was an important part of the cultural fabric of this state,' said Christie. 'She was a cultural icon in this state, and her accomplishments in her life were a source of great pride for the people of this state.' For some New Jerseyans, the songstress was an inspiration. That's particularly true at the Whitney E. Houston Academy of Creative and Performing Arts, a school for pre-kindergarten through eighth grade in East Orange, a few blocks from where the singer spent much of her childhood with her parents and two brothers. Tearful students and staff remembered Houston -- a frequent visitor since the school was named in her honor about 15 years ago -- at a memorial event Monday. In addition to speeches and the release of white balloons, her historic rendition of the national anthem before Super Bowl XXV was replayed. Students told CNN affiliate WCBS afterward that Houston's successes prove that there are no limits for a girl from northern New Jersey. 'I think that I can achieve whatever I want, just like she did,' said eighth-grader Hailey Diasallen. CNN's Maria Santana, Jason Carroll and Kristina Sgueglia contributed to this report.
translated_content: (CNN) -- Mnohí boli ešte v plienkach, ak vôbec boli na svete, počas vrcholného obdobia Whitney Houston na konci 80. a začiatku 90. rokov. A napriek tomu stále cítia zvláštne spojenie s ňou – a dnes zdieľajú bolesť svojich rodičov a susedov, pretože všetci žijú v severnom New Jersey. Mario Depeine povedal, že žiaci na verejnej strednej škole v Newarku, kde učí, neprestávajú hovoriť o Houston, a dodal, že sú rozrušení, pretože sa nekoná žiadna veľká verejná spomienková udalosť, na ktorej by jej mohli vzdať úctu. Väčšina z nich nežila v čase, keď v roku 1986 získala svoju prvú cenu Grammy za najlepší ženský popový výkon za pieseň 'Saving All My Love For You'. Napriek tomu Depeine – iReporter CNN – uviedol, že stredoškoláci poznajú hudbu Houston od svojich rodičov, ako aj jej jedinečné miesto v dejinách Newarku. 'Poznajú ju dobre,' povedal. 'A uvedomujú si, že je skutočne spätá s touto komunitou.' Legendárna speváčka zďaleka nie je prvou osobou narodenou v Newarku, ktorá sa presadila vo svete. Komik Jerry Lewis, hudobník Paul Simon či básnik Allen Ginsberg a mnohí ďalší prišli z tohto mesta s približne 275-tisíc obyvateľmi, ktoré leží 16 kilometrov západne od New Yorku. Houston však mala špeciálne prepojenie, pretože – podľa verejných činiteľov, rodinných priateľov a ďalších obyvateľov – nikdy nezabudla na svoje korene v Newarku, kde sa narodila, a v neďalekom East Orange, kam sa presťahovala ako dieťa. Rozlúčka s rodinou Houston bude súkromná. 'Je to veľmi smutné, pretože v skutočnosti je súčasťou tohto miesta,' povedal German Racines. 'Je malým kúskom Newarku.' Pastor Joe Carter z New Hope Baptist Church v Newarku, ktorý Houston navštevovala v detstve, si spomína, ako prišla zaspievať na niektoré veľkonočné nedeľné bohoslužby aj po tom, čo sa stala slávnou. Iní s láskou spomínali, ako sa často vracala do okolia a správala sa k susedom a členom cirkvi ako k rodine. 'Je to takmer akoby nikdy neodišla,' povedal Sharpe James, bývalý starosta Newarku, ktorý organizoval koncerty pre mladú Houston a jej matku, gospelovú speváčku Cissy Houston. 'Tu je superstar, a predsa ste ju mohli nájsť v Newarku, v kostole. Bola všade, pre všetkých a pre všetko.' Pýcha, spojená s jej ohromným talentom a slávou, je tiež súčasťou jej príťažlivosti v Garden State. Guvernér Chris Christie v utorok povedal novinárom, že verí, že Houston patrí do rovnakej triedy ako Frank Sinatra, Count Basie a Bruce Springsteen, pokiaľ ide o hudobné osobnosti pochádzajúce z New Jersey. Ako poctu oznámil, že nariadi spustiť všetky vlajky na vládnych budovách na pol žrde v sobotu, v deň jej pohrebu. 'Whitney Houston bola dôležitou súčasťou kultúrnej štruktúry tohto štátu,' povedal Christie. 'Bola kultúrnou ikonou v tomto štáte a jej úspechy v živote boli pre obyvateľov tohto štátu zdrojom veľkej hrdosti.' Pre niektorých ľudí z New Jersey bola táto speváčka inšpiráciou. To najmä platí pre Whitney E. Houston Academy of Creative and Performing Arts, školu pre deti od predškolskej až po ôsmu triedu v East Orange, niekoľko blokov od miesta, kde speváčka strávila značnú časť svojho detstva s rodičmi a dvoma bratmi. Dojatí študenti a zamestnanci si Houston – ktorá do školy od jej pomenovania pred približne 15 rokmi často zavítala – pripomenuli počas pondelňajšej spomienky. Okrem prejavov a vypustenia bielych balónov zaznela aj jej historická verzia národnej hymny pred Super Bowlom XXV. Študenti po podujatí povedali pre pobočku CNN WCBS, že úspechy Houston dokazujú, že pre dievča zo severného New Jersey neexistujú žiadne hranice. 'Myslím, že môžem dosiahnuť čokoľvek chcem, presne ako ona,' uviedla ôsmačka Hailey Diasallen. Na tejto správe sa podieľali aj Maria Santana, Jason Carroll a Kristina Sgueglia z CNN.

article_content: By Bianca London (Published: 08:56 EST, 18 February 2014 | Updated: 09:27 EST, 18 February 2014). Despite the dreary weather, Gok Wan aims to brighten wardrobes and banish the winter blues with his latest collection for Tu at Sainsbury’s. This Spring 2014 range, his eleventh for the supermarket giant, embodies the qualities Gok believes a woman’s wardrobe should have: ease, comfort, style, and power. With a focus on separates this season, Gok introduces bow wrap dresses and polka dot twinsets designed to transition seamlessly from desk to dance floor. Gok’s 22-piece collection, available in sizes 8-22, includes beautiful basics made to last and elegant eveningwear sure to impress. Key pieces include a soft cocoon cardigan for on-trend layering, classic skinny jeans, and flattering wrap dresses. Bow collar tops add a touch of sophistication, equally suitable for office wear or a glamorous night out. Soft pastels, delicate whites, and muted mocha tones create a fresh springtime palette, inspired by the season’s focus on pretty pastels. True to Gok’s style, the range landing in store on February 25 showcases clever tailoring tricks and body-enhancing solutions. A peplum skirt and jacquard dress feature an inner control slip for a slender silhouette. James Brown, Director of Tu Clothing, highlights the strong partnership with Gok over the past two years, noting the collection sells quickly, at one piece every 14 seconds. Gok’s philosophy of empowering women with beautiful, flattering clothes resonates perfectly with Sainsbury’s customers.

article_content: 'By Sarah Griffiths. The reality of jet-powered travel is growing ever closer. A Colorado-based company recently demonstrated its small jet pack, called the Go Fast Jet Pack, before a large crowd in a government building.' 'The Go Fast Jet Pack has a maximum speed of 77mph (124km/h) and can reach heights of 250ft (76m). Unlike other jet packs, it is compact, requiring no large frame, wings, or pressurized water jets to fly.' 'Fueled by hydrogen peroxide and nitrogen, the pack converts hydrogen peroxide into high-temperature, high-pressure steam inside rocket nozzles, generating 300lbs of thrust or 800 horsepower for 33 seconds.' 'While it can only cover distances of up to 2,500ft (760m) in its current form, pilots may be able to fly farther as the technology develops. Still, it is dangerous to operate and requires at least 100 hours of training. It is not currently available commercially.' 'The demonstration took place at the Smithsonian Magazine's Future is Here festival at the Ronald Reagan Building and International Trade Center in Washington. The device was piloted by performance pilot Nick Macomber from Jet PI, which took an old Bell Systems model from the 1960s and made it lighter, faster, and more economical.' 'Another jet pack, designed by Swiss inventor Yves Rossy, uses jet engines for propulsion and features a carbon fiber wing with a 6.6ft (2.2m) span, but it cannot take off vertically and must be deployed from a helicopter. Meanwhile, the Martin jet pack, more similar in shape to the Go Fast Jet Pack, relies on twin-ducted fans, can lift off vertically, and can travel up to 19 miles (30km) on a single tank of fuel.'

Spoločnosť z Colorada nedávno predviedla svoj malý raketový batoh s názvom Go Fast Jet Pack pred veľkým publikom vo vládnej budove.' 'Go Fast Jet Pack dosahuje maximálnu rýchlosť 77 mph (124 km/h) a výšku až 250 ft (76 m). Na rozdiel od iných raketových batohov je kompaktný a nevyžaduje veľký rám, krídla ani tlakové vodné trysky.' 'Batoh je poháňaný zmesou peroxidu vodíka a dusíka. Peroxid vodíka sa premieňa na horúcu, vysokotlakovú paru vo vnútri raketových dýz, čím sa vytvára 300 libier ťahu alebo 800 koní na 33 sekúnd.' 'Hoci v súčasnej fáze môže prekonať vzdialenosť len okolo 2 500 ft (760 m), piloti by mohli lietať ďalej s pribúdajúcim pokrokom technológie. Používanie tohto zariadenia je však stále nebezpečné a vyžaduje aspoň 100 hodín výcviku. Momentálne nie je komerčne dostupné.' 'Predstavenie sa konalo počas festivalu Smithsonian Magazine Future is Here v budove Ronald Reagan Building and International Trade Center vo Washingtone. Zariadenie pilotoval akrobatický pilot Nick Macomber zo spoločnosti Jet PI, ktorá vychádzala zo starého modelu Bell Systems zo 60. rokov a vytvorila ľahší, rýchlejší a úspornejší stroj.' 'Ďalší raketový batoh, ktorý vytvoril švajčiarsky vynálezca Yves Rossy, používa prúdové motory na pohon a karbónové krídlo so šírkou 6,6 ft (2,2 m), avšak nedokáže vertikálne vzlietnuť a musí byť spustený z vrtuľníka. Medzitým Martin jet pack, podobný tvarom Go Fast Jet Packu, využíva dvojité ventilátory, dokáže vertikálne vzlietnuť a na jednu nádrž paliva prejde až 19 míľ (30 km).'

article_content: 'A 25-year-old man was blinded in his left eye after being stabbed by a beggar inside Spices, a busy takeaway in Winson Green, Birmingham.' 'On December 5 at around 7pm, the victim and a friend encountered the suspect several times. The beggar first asked for a cigarette, then followed them into the kebab house, persistently requesting money. After the sixth refusal, the suspect plunged a weapon into the victim's left eye. The man was rushed to Birmingham's City Hospital and underwent surgery, but lost sight in that eye.' 'Detective Constable Sharon Duncan of West Midlands Police said the victim and his friend offered to buy the beggar food instead of giving money. Despite this, the suspect continued to ask for cash. She described the suspect as mixed race, approximately 5ft 6ins tall, wearing a light grey hooded top with white writing. Police are appealing for witnesses to this horrific incident.'
translated_content: 'Dvadsaťpäťročný muž oslepol na ľavé oko po tom, ako ho v reštaurácii Spices v rušnej štvrti Winson Green v Birminghame napadol žobrák.' 'Piateho decembra okolo 19.00 hodiny sa obeť a jeho priateľ s podozrivým stretli viackrát. Žobrák najprv žiadal cigaretu a potom ich nasledoval do kebabového podniku, pričom neprestajne pýtal peniaze. Po šiestom odmietnutí žobrák bodol obeť do ľavého oka. Muža urýchlene previezli do birminghamskej City Hospital, kde podstúpil operáciu, no prišiel o zrak v postihnutom oku.' 'Detektívka Sharon Duncan z polície West Midlands uviedla, že obeť a jeho priateľ ponúkli žobrákovi jedlo namiesto peňazí. Napriek tomu páchateľ naďalej žiadal peniaze. Opísala ho ako muža zmiešanej rasovej príslušnosti, vysokého približne 167 cm, ktorý mal oblečenú svetlosivú mikinu s bielym nápisom. Polícia vyzýva svedkov tohto hrozného činu, aby sa prihlásili.'

article_content: Kevin De Bruyne has made such a remarkable impact at Wolfsburg this season that his former club Chelsea reportedly regrets letting him go, according to general manager Klaus Allofs. The 23-year-old moved to the Bundesliga side for £17 million in January 2014 after realizing he would struggle for first-team opportunities at Stamford Bridge. The Belgium international is enjoying a strong first full season with the Wolves, scoring eight league goals as they trail Bayern Munich, who are eight points ahead. Klaus Allofs cites De Bruyne's stellar form as evidence of why Chelsea regrets selling him, saying: 'At Chelsea they watch with appreciation as Kevin has developed. They've seen confirmed why they were reluctant to let him leave.' De Bruyne's time at Chelsea was frustrating, having made only five starts following his arrival from Genk in January 2012. He spent the 2012/13 campaign on loan at Werder Bremen, netting 10 goals in 34 appearances. De Bruyne's lack of chances at Stamford Bridge mirrored Andre Schurrle's, who left Chelsea for Wolfsburg in a £24 million deal. Both players are expected to feature together in Wolfsburg's upcoming match against Bayer Leverkusen.

Dvadsaťtriročný hráč prestúpil do bundesligového tímu za 17 miliónov libier v januári 2014 po tom, ako si uvedomil, že na Stamford Bridge by nemal veľa príležitostí v prvom tíme. Belgický reprezentant si užíva silnú prvú plnú sezónu vo farbách Wolves, keď strelil osem ligových gólov a strácajú osem bodov na Bayern Mníchov. Klaus Allofs uvádza De Bruyneho skvelú formu ako dôkaz, prečo Chelsea ľutuje, že ho predala, a hovorí: 'V Chelsea sa s uznaním pozerajú na to, ako sa Kevin vyvinul. Videli potvrdené to, prečo ho pôvodne nechceli nechať odísť.' De Bruyneho obdobie v Chelsea bolo frustrujúce, keďže po príchode z Genku v januári 2012 nastúpil len v piatich zápasoch v základnej zostave. Sezónu 2012/13 strávil na hosťovaní vo Werderi Brémy, kde strelil 10 gólov v 34 zápasoch. Jeho nedostatok príležitostí na Stamford Bridge sa podobal situácii Andreho Schurrleho, ktorý z Chelsea prestúpil do Wolfsburgu za 24 miliónov libier. Obaja hráči by mali nastúpiť spoločne v blížiacom sa zápase Wolfsburgu proti Bayeru Leverkusen.
